verdict.rationale: Summer Engine's marketing says it can target the web, so browser deployment is a documented capability, but only as a single platform-list mention. Nothing describes the web build's payload size, its rendering backend, or WebGL/WebGPU support. Missing for 10: documented WebGL rendering, a WebGPU roadmap or support, payload/bundle-size figures or optimization guidance, web-export docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration of browser builds.

support.subject: As a web developer, my game runs in the browser with a reasonable payload — WebGL today, and a credible WebGPU story

citations.quote: Make games for Windows, Mac, Linux, iOS, Android and the web.
